title: GAIA ERW Pipeline — Workflow Viewer
subtitle: Click a workflow on the left to highlight its path through the components and see what is passed between each step.

components.name: GADM v4
components.description: Global administrative boundaries; world polygons and ISO codes.

components.name: QED cropland
components.description: Cropland fraction raster for Africa from the QED geosurvey.

components.name: SoilGrids Africa
components.description: Depth-stratified soil chemistry: pH, bulk density, exchangeable acidity, K/Ca/Mg/Na bases.

components.name: SPAM v2 Africa
components.description: Per-crop harvested area, production, and yield rasters for 23 crops.

components.name: EcoCrop tolerance XLSX
components.description: Per-crop pH and acidity-saturation tolerance ranges. Manual input.

components.name: FAOSTAT prices
components.description: Producer prices 2016–2020 for SSA countries (manual CSV download).

components.name: WorldClim v2
components.description: Mean annual temperature and precipitation rasters.

components.name: GLiM v1.0 lithology
components.description: Global lithology map. Basic volcanic class flags basalt outcrops.

components.name: MAP friction 2019
components.description: Travel-time friction surface (minutes per meter), Weiss et al.

components.name: Ember + IEA + GET.invest
components.description: Country-level electricity prices and grid carbon intensity for SSA (manually compiled table).

components.name: ERW field-trial dataset
components.description: Manually-compiled yield-response and CDR-rate observations from published ERW trials (Kisumu, Corn Belt, InPlanet, Newcastle oats, Swiss vineyards, etc.).

components.name: terra
components.description: Raster GIS engine. All scripts use it for I/O, masking, arithmetic.

components.name: geodata
components.description: Downloaders for SoilGrids, SPAM, WorldClim, GADM.

components.name: limer
components.description: gaiafrica/limer: lime-requirement methods (Kamprath, Cochrane, LiTAS) and NPV helpers.

components.name: Recocrop
components.description: EcoCrop suitability model: per-crop relative yield from environmental responses.

components.name: malariaAtlas
components.description: Downloader for MAP friction surface (used by erw-basalt-access).

components.name: brms
components.description: Bayesian regression models via Stan. Used to fit the trial-calibrated yield-response model.

components.name: SoilGrids layers
components.description: Build SSA mask, pull and depth-weight-average SoilGrids variables, derive ECEC and acidity saturation, mask to cropland.

components.name: SPAM crop layers
components.description: Pull SPAM area/production/yield for 23 crops, crop to SSA, resample to working grid.

components.name: Basalt requirements
components.description: Compute lime-equivalent CaCO3 rates via limer::limeRate, then Lewis-2021-calibrated lime→basalt conversion with grain size as a decision variable. Produces both LiTAS-targeted and uniform-rate (10/20/50 t/ha) rasters.

components.name: Crop parameters
components.description: Per-crop pH and acidity-tolerance tables. Produces ecocrop_parameters_{ph,hp}.csv and crop_types.csv.

components.name: Yield-loss function
components.description: Per-crop relative-yield rasters from Recocrop::ecocrop applied to soil pH and acidity saturation.

components.name: CDR yield
components.description: Per-pixel CDR (t CO2/ha): climate-and-pH-scaled, with aridity-driven pedogenic-carbonate deduction.

components.name: Basalt access
components.description: Cost-distance from basalt outcrops. Produces transport-km and delivered-price rasters.

components.name: Country energy
components.description: Per-country electricity price + grid carbon intensity rasters for SSA — drives spatial grinding economics and LCA.

components.name: ERW profitability
components.description: Decomposed cost (quarry + grinding + transport + spreading), derived LCA, MRV deduction, time-resolved CDR (NPV regime), four allocation rules.

components.name: ERW sensitivity
components.description: Five sweeps: prices × MRV × yields × grain size × allocation rule.

components.name: Supply ranking
components.description: Supply-constrained deployment: ranks pixels by GM-per-tonne-basalt; outputs supply-curve CSVs and deployment masks for several Mt/yr caps.

components.name: Yield fit (Bayesian)
components.description: Bayesian hierarchical regression of log yield-ratio on rate, climate, baseline pH, grain size, and crop type. Fitted on the manually-compiled trial dataset.

components.name: Yield predict
components.description: Applies the posterior from erw-yield-fit to the SSA raster grid to produce per-crop yield-uplift rasters for use by erw-7.

flows.name: Build country energy rasters
flows.description: Subflow: produce per-country electricity price and grid carbon intensity rasters for SSA. The CI spread (~30× across SSA) is the load-bearing factor in grinding-emissions LCA.

Outputs: electricity_usd_kWh.tif + grid_CI_kg_per_kWh.tif. Consumed automatically by erw-7.

flows.name: Compute spatial CDR yield (with pedogenic deduction)
flows.description: Climate × pH × aridity scaling of the constant basalt-CDR factor from erw-3. The pedogenic-carbonate deduction can remove 70–90% of theoretical CDR in semi-arid pixels.

flows.description: Cost-distance from basalt outcrops over the MAP friction surface. Outputs an explicit transport-km raster used by erw-7 for the LCA truck-emissions component.

flows.description: Five sweep axes over the ERW economics: prices × MRV × yields × grain size × allocation rule. The grain-size sweep reveals the cost-vs-reactivity trade-off.

flows.name: Supply-constrained deployment ranking
flows.description: Post-process: rank cropland pixels by GM-per-tonne-basalt under several annual basalt-supply caps (1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500 Mt/yr). Produces supply curves and deployment-mask rasters.

steps.note: Per-pixel basalt tonnes (rate × area), GM ($), aggregated across 23 crops.
Used to compute total delivered CDR (Mt CO2) under each supply cap.
This is the LP-dual ranking when basalt is the scarce input.
Marginal pixel's GM-per-t-basalt at each cap = the shadow price of basalt at that supply level.
Deployment-mask rasters at caps of 10, 50, 250 Mt/yr.

flows.name: Calibrate yield response from ERW trials (Bayesian)
flows.description: Fits a Bayesian hierarchical regression of log(yield_with_basalt / yield_control) on application rate, climate, baseline soil pH, grain size, and crop type. Produces per-crop posterior-predictive yield-uplift rasters that replace the EcoCrop-derived response in erw-7.

steps.passes: Trial-level observations: site, crop, rate, grain, MAT, MAP, pH, log_y_ratio, sd
steps.note: ~15 published data points (Kisumu, Corn Belt, InPlanet, Newcastle oats, Swiss vineyards, mesocosm).
Hierarchical model: log_y_ratio ~ log(rate) + s(MAT) + s(MAP) + pH + log(grain) + (1|crop) + (1|site).
Saved as RDS; small-n dataset → priors dominate, large posterior intervals expected.
Predict step loads it and applies to per-pixel covariates.

Median + 5th/95th percentile rasters written per crop.
erw-7 uses these in place of EcoCrop response when the rasters are detected.
